_about: Data for the daar station v2 (design system §13), the combined station js/cook/stations/daar.js: chop what Nani's card says on the board (tap a crate, tap the knife; the pieces go into the katori), then the tadka in the pot on the kitchen kit's hob (one burner, one pot: the knob, the spices in the order Nani says, the chopped vegetables, the daar) and stir as many times as Nani says. Serve and taste (§14a). mechanic.levels (merged in order): vegDecoys / spiceDecoys (extra crates and jars on the shelf), spiceShelf (where the spice decoys come from), ladder (how the card shows the tadka order: words | dots | hidden, as the tadka mechanic), heatRate (how fast the oil heats, ring per second). `phases`: one English line per job (placeholders, like every station goal).

station.name: Daar
station.goal: Chop what Nani's card says, add the spices in the order she says, then stir as many times as she says.

phases.chop: Tap a vegetable, then the knife. Chop what Nani's card says, then tap the tick.
phases.cook: Turn on the hob, add the spices in the order Nani says, then the vegetables and the daar.

levels.stirLine: Stir round the pot as many times as Nani says, then tap the tick.
